column1: # cargo-nix-hints.tsv — the cargo→nix equivalent HINT MAP the cargo-nix-shim prints (all-nix mandate,
# operator 2026-08-29). OWNERSHIP: v-fleet-tooling owns the wrapper mechanism; v-nix OWNS this map's
# CONTENT (the nix-equivalent knowledge) — v-nix PRs entries as it lands apps. The shim reads this via
# `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`/fleet/cargo-nix-hints.tsv (tracked → checked out in every worktree).
# FORMAT: one entry per line, KEY<TAB>HINT. Blank lines + `#` comments ignored. KEY = the cargo shape the
# shim computes from argv (see cargo-nix-shim.sh key_for): the `xtask:<sub>` forms for `cargo xtask <sub>`,
# else the bare cargo subcommand. A cargo command with NO key here → generic warn + logged to the gaps file
# (~/.cdz-cargo-gaps.tsv) for v-nix to add an equivalent. `cargo xtask fleet …` is EXEMPT (control plane).

column2: nix run .#build   (interim until apps.build lands: nix run .#cdz — self-contained warm bin+store)
cargo xtask fleet gate-local   (nix local-gate; or nix run .#gate)
nix run .#<app>   (if an app exists; else this is a gap — flag v-nix)
nix run .#fmt   (or the pre-commit hook auto-fmts)
